_comment: Completeness scoring. categoryWeights are relative importance and need not sum to anything; they are normalized at runtime. They are set from the observed deficiency rates in the 656-record analysis, so the meter pushes hardest on what is most often missing.
_comment_credit: How much a question contributes to its categories depending on how it was answered. 'unresolved' is an escape hatch with a stated reason - deliberately worth something but well short of an answer, so the meter never reads green on justifications alone.
